steps: Heat the oil in a pot and let the cumin seeds sizzle, then add a pinch of hing.
Fry the onion and green chilli until light golden.
Stir in the ginger and garlic until they stop smelling raw.
Add the chopped or blended tomato and cook until it turns soft and pulpy.
Mix in the coriander powder, chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala and salt, and fry until oil shows at the edges.
Add the potato and peas and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in about a cup of hot water for two people, cover, and simmer until the potato is soft.
Crush in the kasuri methi, top with coriander leaves and serve with roti or rice.
note: Both sources make a homely gravy without cream, so the cream is gone. Amounts are the middle of the two; peas come down a little to about a quarter cup a person.
